svg.title: Known-best n=69: descriptive contact census
svg.desc: House rendering of known-best n=69 with dashed graph edges for contacts detected at angle tolerance 1e-06 radians and contact tolerance 0.001. Lines join square centres or centres to walls; they are descriptive graph incidence, not exact physical contact loci or rigidity certificates.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Coordinates were recovered from the public six-decimal SVG rendering, not the unavailable governed interval boxes named by its metadata. This checks the displayed construction only and does not replay the source's interval claim or prove optimality.

g.data-semantics: tolerance-qualified graph edges, not exact contact loci
